lines.n1: Node.js runs JavaScript outside the browser, on Chrome's V8 engine.
lines.n2: Most servers spend their time waiting on databases, files and networks.
lines.n3: Instead of one thread per request, Node uses one thread and an event loop.
lines.n4: A slow operation is handed off. When it finishes, its callback is queued and run.
lines.n5: Thousands of connections stay cheap, but one heavy calculation blocks everyone.
lines.n6: So Node shines at I O heavy work, and uses worker threads for heavy CPU jobs.
